quote: Drivers of vehicles proceeding in opposite directions shall pass each other keeping to the right, and upon highways having width for not more than one line of traffic in each direction, each driver shall give to the other at least one-half of the paved portion of the highway as nearly as possible.

activation.condition: Vehicles proceed in opposite directions; the additional paved-allocation clause applies on a highway with width for no more than one traffic line in each direction.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Physical allocation feasibility and surrounding constraints require independent source and original observation.

obligation.description: Pass while keeping to the right; on a qualifying highway give the other driver at least one-half of the paved portion as nearly as possible.

timing.description: Original simultaneous actor bodies and motion during the opposing pass, with source-reviewed paved geometry and traffic-line capacity.
